desc:
Escape from the prison you are in!

⭐️UPD7 Equipments Coming！！！
⚙️Please click the gear icon if you have any suggestions.

[How to play]
🏋️Make your frail body stronger.
💲Dig deeper underground to obtain more cash.
💎Discovering treasures in different soil layers.
🚀The jetpack will enable you to move around freely.
👮If you don't pay attention to the digging time, you'll be captured.
